:::{#sol-prac-exp-mle-maximum .solution}

The [second derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-second-derivative) from @sol-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative, evaluated at $\hat\pmean_{ML} = \bar{x}$ from @sol-prac-exp-mle-mle is

$$
\hess(\bar{x}; \vx)
= \frac{n}{\bar{x}^2} - \frac{2n\bar{x}}{\bar{x}^3}
= \frac{n}{\bar{x}^2} - \frac{2n}{\bar{x}^2}
= -\frac{n}{\bar{x}^2} < 0
$$

Since the second derivative is negative, $\hat\pmean_{ML} = \bar{x}$ is a maximum.

:::
